component.name: ibm-watsonx-ai
component.title: IBM watsonx.ai
component.description: Generate text, chat, embed, rerank and tokenize text, extract and classify documents, detect harmful content and forecast time series with the foundation models and deployments of IBM watsonx.ai.
component.label: ai,cloud

baseUrl.label: common
baseUrl.description: The watsonx.ai API URL of the region, such as https://us-south.ml.cloud.ibm.com or https://eu-de.ml.cloud.ibm.com. The endpoint does not start without it, unless its operation is runTool or listTools, which call the wxUrl instead, or processToolCalls, which runs locally.

projectId.label: common
projectId.description: The ID of the watsonx.ai project in which the operations of foundation models (textGeneration, chat, embedding, rerank, tokenize, forecast and their streaming variants), detection, text extraction and text classification run. Set projectId or spaceId. deploymentInfo looks the deployment up in this project when no space ID is set.

spaceId.label: common
spaceId.description: The ID of the deployment space, in the place of projectId, in which the same operations run. deploymentInfo looks the deployment up in this space; there the CamelIBMWatsonxAiSpaceId header overrides it.

wxUrl.label: common
wxUrl.description: The watsonx.ai platform (WX) API URL of the region, such as https://api.dataplatform.cloud.ibm.com/wx or https://api.eu-de.dataplatform.cloud.ibm.com/wx, which runTool and listTools call. Required for these two operations.

autoRotationCorrection.label: producer
autoRotationCorrection.description: Whether text extraction and classification correct the rotation of the pages

classificationMode.label: producer
classificationMode.description: How text classification classifies: exact (the document type) or binary (whether it is one)

configuration.description: The configuration that the endpoints share. Each endpoint starts from a copy of it, and its URI options override the copied values.

cosUrl.label: producer
cosUrl.description: The endpoint URL of the IBM Cloud Object Storage region of the document and result buckets, such as https://s3.us-south.cloud-object-storage.appdomain.cloud. Required for text extraction and text classification.

deploymentId.label: producer
deploymentId.description: The ID of the deployment of deploymentInfo, deploymentGenerate, deploymentChat and deploymentForecast. The CamelIBMWatsonxAiDeploymentId header overrides it; when neither is set, these operations fail.

detectHap.label: producer
detectHap.description: Whether detect looks for hate, abuse and profanity (HAP), when neither the detectors option nor the CamelIBMWatsonxAiDetectors header is set. When neither detectPii nor detectHap is set, detect uses both detectors.

detectionThreshold.label: producer
detectionThreshold.description: The threshold (0 to 1) of the detectors of detect, detectContext and detectGenerated, but the PII detector, which takes none. The defaults of watsonx.ai apply when not set.

detectors.label: producer
detectors.description: The detectors, comma separated, in the place of detectPii and detectHap: hap, pii and granite_guardian for detect, context_relevance and faithfulness for detectContext (default context_relevance), answer_relevance for detectGenerated (default answer_relevance). The detectionThreshold applies to all but pii

detectPii.label: producer
detectPii.description: Whether detect looks for personal identifiable information (PII), when neither the detectors option nor the CamelIBMWatsonxAiDetectors header is set. When neither detectPii nor detectHap is set, detect uses both detectors.

documentBucket.label: producer
documentBucket.description: The Cloud Object Storage bucket of the documents of text extraction and text classification: the upload operations upload into it, and the operations with a file path read the document from it. Required for these operations.

documentConnectionId.label: producer
documentConnectionId.description: The ID of the connection asset, in the project or space, that gives watsonx.ai access to the documentBucket. Required for text extraction and text classification.

documentLanguages.label: producer
documentLanguages.description: The languages of the documents of text extraction and classification, comma separated ISO 639 codes, such as en,fr

embeddedImages.label: producer
embeddedImages.description: What text extraction does with the images of the document

extractionMode.label: producer
extractionMode.description: The quality of text extraction: standard or high_quality

extractionOutputs.label: producer
extractionOutputs.description: The outputs of text extraction, comma separated: md (the default), json, html, plain_text, page_images. The operations that return the text (AndFetch) take one output, but page_images

frequencyPenalty.label: producer
frequencyPenalty.description: The penalty of chat for tokens in proportion to how often they already appear, from -2 to 2: positive values make the answer repeat itself less. There is no header for it.

governanceInstanceId.label: producer
governanceInstanceId.description: The watsonx.governance instance that runs the detectors of detectContext and detectGenerated (and of detect, in the place of the project or space), which IBM Cloud requires for them

guidedChoice.label: producer
guidedChoice.description: Guided decoding of chat: the answer is one of these comma separated choices

guidedGrammar.label: producer
guidedGrammar.description: Guided decoding of chat: the answer follows this context free grammar (EBNF)

guidedRegex.label: producer
guidedRegex.description: Guided decoding of chat: the answer matches this regular expression

includeReasoning.label: producer
includeReasoning.description: Whether watsonx.ai returns the reasoning of the model, in the CamelIBMWatsonxAiReasoningContent header

jsonSchema.label: producer
jsonSchema.description: A JSON schema (as JSON text) that the chat answer follows (the json_schema response format)

jsonSchemaStrict.label: producer
jsonSchemaStrict.description: Whether the chat answer must follow the jsonSchema strictly

kvpMode.label: producer
kvpMode.description: The key-value pair extraction of text extraction: disabled, invoice, ubill or generic_with_semantic. When not set, text extraction extracts no key-value pairs.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

maxCompletionTokens.label: producer
maxCompletionTokens.description: The maximum number of tokens of the answer of chat, chatStreaming and deploymentChat. The CamelIBMWatsonxAiMaxNewTokens header overrides it.

maxNewTokens.label: producer
maxNewTokens.description: The maximum number of tokens that textGeneration, textGenerationStreaming and deploymentGenerate generate. Chat uses maxCompletionTokens instead. The CamelIBMWatsonxAiMaxNewTokens header overrides it.

modelId.label: producer
modelId.description: The ID of the foundation model, such as ibm/granite-4-h-small, of textGeneration, chat, embedding, rerank, tokenize, forecast and their streaming variants. The CamelIBMWatsonxAiModelId header overrides it for chat and chatStreaming. The deployment operations use the model of the deployment instead.

moderationGraniteGuardian.label: producer
moderationGraniteGuardian.description: Chat guardrail: whether watsonx.ai checks the input with Granite Guardian (watsonx.ai applies it to the input only)

moderationHap.label: producer
moderationHap.description: Chat guardrail: whether watsonx.ai checks the input and the answer for hate, abuse and profanity (HAP)

moderationPii.label: producer
moderationPii.description: Chat guardrail: whether watsonx.ai checks the input and the answer for personal identifiable information (PII)

moderationThreshold.label: producer
moderationThreshold.description: The threshold (0 to 1) of the HAP and Granite Guardian chat guardrails

numberOfChoices.label: producer
numberOfChoices.description: How many answers chat generates for the request (n). The body is the first one, and the CamelIBMWatsonxAiAssistantMessages header has them all

ocrMode.label: producer
ocrMode.description: The optical character recognition of text extraction and classification: auto, disabled, enabled or forced

operation.label: producer
operation.description: The operation to perform. The CamelIBMWatsonxAiOperation header overrides it; when neither is set, the exchange fails.

outputDpi.label: producer
outputDpi.description: The resolution, in dots per inch, of the images that text extraction outputs.

outputTokens.label: producer
outputTokens.description: Whether text extraction gives the tokens of the text, with their positions

predictionLength.label: producer
predictionLength.description: The number of time steps to forecast (forecast and deploymentForecast). The model forecasts its own default length when not set

presencePenalty.label: producer
presencePenalty.description: The penalty of chat for any token that already appeared, from -2 to 2: positive values make the model move on to new topics. There is no header for it.

processingTimeout.label: producer
processingTimeout.description: How long the text extraction and classification operations that wait (AndFetch) wait for the result, in milliseconds. Defaults to the timeout of the endpoint

reasoningEffort.label: producer
reasoningEffort.description: How much the model of chat reasons: low, medium or high, for the models that support it

removeOutputFile.label: producer
removeOutputFile.description: Whether the text extraction operations that wait (AndFetch) remove the output file from Cloud Object Storage once read (asynchronously)

removeUploadedFile.label: producer
removeUploadedFile.description: Whether the operations that upload and wait (UploadAndFetch) remove the uploaded document from Cloud Object Storage once the result is read (asynchronously)

repetitionPenalty.label: producer
repetitionPenalty.description: The penalty of text generation for repeating tokens it already generated: 1 means no penalty, and higher values repeat less. Chat does not use it (see frequencyPenalty). The CamelIBMWatsonxAiRepetitionPenalty header overrides it.

rerankTopN.label: producer
rerankTopN.description: The number of best ranked inputs that rerank returns. The CamelIBMWatsonxAiRerankTopN header overrides it.

responseFormat.label: producer
responseFormat.description: The format of the chat answer: text, or json for a JSON object. Set jsonSchema for an answer that follows a JSON schema

resultBucket.label: producer
resultBucket.description: The Cloud Object Storage bucket where text extraction writes its output files, which textExtractionReadFile and textExtractionDeleteFile read and delete unless the CamelIBMWatsonxAiBucketName header names another bucket. Required for text extraction.

resultConnectionId.label: producer
resultConnectionId.description: The ID of the connection asset, in the project or space, that gives watsonx.ai access to the resultBucket. Required for text extraction.

returnDocuments.label: producer
returnDocuments.description: Whether each result of rerank includes its input text, besides its index and score.

seed.label: producer
seed.description: The random seed of chat sampling, for repeatable answers

stop.label: producer
stop.description: Comma separated sequences that stop the generation of the chat answer

streamEndpoint.label: producer
streamEndpoint.description: The endpoint URI, such as seda:chunks, that receives each chunk of textGenerationStreaming and chatStreaming as a message when the CamelIBMWatsonxAiStreamConsumer header is not set. The chunks are sent from the threads of the watsonx.ai SDK, with the exchange ID of the streaming exchange in the CamelCorrelationId header.

temperature.label: producer
temperature.description: The sampling temperature of text generation and chat (the streaming and deployment operations included), from 0 to 2: higher values give more random text. The CamelIBMWatsonxAiTemperature header overrides it.

thinking.label: producer
thinking.description: Whether the model of chat reasons before it answers, for the models that support it (chat template thinking)

thinkingTags.label: producer
thinkingTags.description: For models that write their reasoning in the answer between tags: the tag of the reasoning, and optionally the tag of the answer after a comma, such as think,response. The reasoning goes to the CamelIBMWatsonxAiReasoningContent header and the answer to the body

toolChoice.label: producer
toolChoice.description: How the model chooses the tools of chat: auto (the model decides), required (the model must call a tool), none (the model must not call a tool), or the name of the tool the model must call

topK.label: producer
topK.description: The top-k sampling of text generation: the model picks the next token from this number of most likely tokens. Chat does not use it. The CamelIBMWatsonxAiTopK header overrides it.

topP.label: producer
topP.description: The nucleus sampling of text generation and chat: the model picks the next token from the most likely tokens whose probabilities add up to this value (0 to 1). The CamelIBMWatsonxAiTopP header overrides it.

truncateInputTokens.label: producer
truncateInputTokens.description: The maximum number of tokens of each input text of embedding: a longer input is truncated from the end, so that the request does not fail.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

logRequests.label: advanced
logRequests.description: Whether to log HTTP requests to the watsonx.ai API

logResponses.label: advanced
logResponses.description: Whether to log HTTP responses from the watsonx.ai API

timeout.label: advanced
timeout.description: The timeout of each HTTP request to watsonx.ai and to IBM Cloud IAM, in milliseconds; the watsonx.ai SDK uses 60 seconds when not set. The streaming operations wait for the end of the stream at most this timeout and 30 seconds more.

apiKey.label: security
apiKey.description: The IBM Cloud API key, exchanged at IBM Cloud IAM for an access token that is sent to watsonx.ai. Required unless oauthProfile or authenticator is set, or the operation is processToolCalls, which runs locally; when several are set, authenticator is used first, then oauthProfile.

oauthProfile.label: security
oauthProfile.description: OAuth profile name for obtaining an access token via the OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials grant. When set, the token of the configured identity provider is sent to watsonx.ai as a Bearer token instead of an IBM Cloud API key, and obtained again when it expires. Requires camel-oauth on the classpath.

verifySsl.label: security
verifySsl.description: Whether the watsonx.ai SDK verifies the TLS certificates of watsonx.ai, IBM Cloud IAM and Cloud Object Storage. Set it to false only for testing, as the connections then accept any certificate.

authenticator.label: security,advanced
authenticator.description: A custom authenticator of the watsonx.ai SDK (com.ibm.watsonx.ai.core.auth.Authenticator) that gives the token of every request, such as a CP4DAuthenticator for watsonx.ai software on Cloud Pak for Data. When set, apiKey and oauthProfile are not used.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiOperation.description: The operation to perform. Overrides the operation option.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiInput.description: The input text, in the place of the body, of textGeneration, textGenerationStreaming, tokenize, deploymentGenerate, detect, detectContext and detectGenerated (for which it is the generated text).

CamelIBMWatsonxAiInputs.description: The input texts, in the place of the body, of embedding (the texts to embed) and rerank (the texts to rank), as a List of Strings.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiGeneratedText.description: The generated text of textGeneration, deploymentGenerate, chat, deploymentChat and the streaming operations, which is also the body. For chat, the content of the first answer.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiModelId.label: producer
CamelIBMWatsonxAiModelId.description: The model of chat and chatStreaming for this request, overriding the modelId option. embedding, rerank, tokenize, forecast and deploymentForecast set it to the model that answered.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiDeploymentId.description: The ID of the deployment of the deployment operations. Overrides the deploymentId option.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiSpaceId.description: The ID of the deployment space in which deploymentInfo looks the deployment up. Overrides the spaceId option for deploymentInfo only.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiDeploymentName.description: The name of the deployment, set by deploymentInfo.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiDeploymentAssetType.description: The type of the asset that the deployment serves, set by deploymentInfo.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiDeploymentStatus.description: The state of the deployment, set by deploymentInfo.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiTemperature.description: The sampling temperature of text generation and chat. Overrides the temperature option.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiMaxNewTokens.description: The maximum number of tokens to generate. Overrides the maxNewTokens option for text generation and the maxCompletionTokens option for chat.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiTopP.description: The nucleus sampling of text generation and chat. Overrides the topP option.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiTopK.description: The top-k sampling of text generation. Overrides the topK option.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiRepetitionPenalty.description: The repetition penalty of text generation. Overrides the repetitionPenalty option.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiMessages.description: The chat messages (ChatMessage objects, or Strings as user messages) to send, in the place of the body. When the model answers chat with tool calls, chat sets it to the messages it sent, which processToolCalls extends with the tool calls and the tool results, so the next chat sends the whole conversation

CamelIBMWatsonxAiSystemMessage.description: The system message of chat, chatStreaming and deploymentChat, sent before the user message when the CamelIBMWatsonxAiMessages header is not set. Ignored when the body is a ChatMessage or a List of messages.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiUserMessage.description: The user message of chat, chatStreaming and deploymentChat, in the place of the body, when the CamelIBMWatsonxAiMessages header is not set.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiTools.description: The tools that the model of chat, chatStreaming and deploymentChat may call, as a List of com.ibm.watsonx.ai.chat.model.Tool.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiToolChoice.description: How the model chooses the tools of chat, overriding the toolChoice option: auto, required, none, or the name of the tool the model must call

CamelIBMWatsonxAiResponseFormat.description: The format of the chat answer, overriding the responseFormat and jsonSchema options: text or json

CamelIBMWatsonxAiJsonSchema.description: The JSON schema the chat answer follows, overriding the jsonSchema and responseFormat options: JSON text or a Map

CamelIBMWatsonxAiGuidedChoice.description: Guided decoding of chat, overriding the guidedChoice option: the choices of the answer, as a List or comma separated

CamelIBMWatsonxAiSeed.description: The random seed of chat sampling, overriding the seed option

CamelIBMWatsonxAiStop.description: The stop sequences of chat, overriding the stop option: a List, or comma separated

CamelIBMWatsonxAiReasoningEffort.description: How much the model of chat reasons, overriding the reasoningEffort option: low, medium or high

CamelIBMWatsonxAiReasoningContent.label: producer
CamelIBMWatsonxAiReasoningContent.description: The reasoning of the model that preceded the chat answer, when it gives one

CamelIBMWatsonxAiRefusal.label: producer
CamelIBMWatsonxAiRefusal.description: The refusal of the model to answer, when it refuses

CamelIBMWatsonxAiAssistantMessages.label: producer
CamelIBMWatsonxAiAssistantMessages.description: All the answers of chat when it generates more than one (numberOfChoices), the body being the first

CamelIBMWatsonxAiModerationResults.label: producer
CamelIBMWatsonxAiModerationResults.description: The findings of the chat guardrails (moderationHap, moderationPii, moderationGraniteGuardian), by detector

CamelIBMWatsonxAiEmbeddings.description: The embedding vectors of embedding, one List of Floats per input, which is also the body.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiRerankQuery.description: The query that rerank ranks the inputs against. Required for rerank.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiRerankTopN.description: The number of best ranked inputs that rerank returns. Overrides the rerankTopN option.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiTokenCount.description: The number of tokens of the input of tokenize, which is also the body.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiTokens.description: The tokens of the input of tokenize.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiFile.description: The local file that the upload operations of text extraction and text classification upload, when the body is not a file.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiFileName.description: The name of the document that the upload operations upload when the body is not a file, else taken from the CamelAwsS3Key, CamelAzureStorageBlobBlobName or CamelFileName header. For textExtractionReadFile, textExtractionDeleteFile and textClassificationDeleteFile, the name of the file to read or delete, in the place of the body.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiFilePath.description: The path of the document in the documentBucket that textExtraction, textExtractionAndFetch, textClassification and textClassificationAndFetch process, in the place of the body.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiOutputFileName.description: The name of the output file of text extraction, in the result bucket

CamelIBMWatsonxAiExtractionId.description: The ID of the text extraction request: set by textExtraction, textExtractionUpload and textExtractionFetch, and read by textExtractionFetch and textExtractionDeleteRequest in the place of the body.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiExtractionStatus.description: The status of the text extraction request, such as submitted, running, completed or failed, set by textExtraction, textExtractionUpload and textExtractionFetch.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiExtractedText.description: The extracted text of textExtractionUploadAndFetch and textExtractionAndFetch, which is also the body.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiBucketName.description: The Cloud Object Storage bucket of the file that textExtractionReadFile, textExtractionDeleteFile (default the resultBucket) and textClassificationDeleteFile (default the documentBucket) read or delete.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiUploadSuccess.description: Whether textExtractionUploadFile or textClassificationUploadFile uploaded the file, which is also the body.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiDeleteSuccess.description: Whether the DeleteFile or DeleteRequest operation of text extraction or text classification deleted the file or the request, which is also the body.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiClassificationId.description: The ID of the text classification request: set by textClassification, textClassificationUpload and textClassificationFetch, and read by textClassificationFetch and textClassificationDeleteRequest in the place of the body.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiClassificationStatus.description: The status of the text classification request, such as submitted, running, completed or failed, set by the text classification operations that start, fetch or wait for it.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiClassificationResult.description: The document type that text classification found, set by textClassificationFetch and the AndFetch operations of text classification.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiDocumentClassified.description: Whether text classification classified the document, set by textClassificationFetch and the AndFetch operations of text classification.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiErrorMessage.description: The error message of a failed text extraction or text classification request, set by textExtractionFetch and textClassificationFetch.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiErrorCode.description: The error code of a failed text extraction or text classification request, set by textExtractionFetch and textClassificationFetch.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiDetectors.description: The detectors of detect, detectContext and detectGenerated, as a List of com.ibm.watsonx.ai.detection.detector.BaseDetector. Overrides the detectors, detectPii and detectHap options.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiDetectionContext.description: The context of detectContext: the documents, as a List of texts or URLs, or one String

CamelIBMWatsonxAiDetectionPrompt.description: The prompt that the generated text of the body of detectGenerated answers

CamelIBMWatsonxAiDetected.description: Whether harmful content was detected: true when a detector found something, not counting a Granite Guardian answer of No

CamelIBMWatsonxAiDetectionResults.description: Detection results grouped by type: the detection, score and text (and start and end for detect, evidence for detectContext) of each

CamelIBMWatsonxAiDetectionCount.description: Count of the detections that watsonx.ai returned, including Granite Guardian answers of No

CamelIBMWatsonxAiStreamConsumer.description: The java.util.function.Consumer of String that receives each chunk of textGenerationStreaming and chatStreaming. Overrides the streamEndpoint option; one of them is required for these operations.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiInputTokenCount.description: The number of tokens of the input, set by text generation, chat, embedding and rerank.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiOutputTokenCount.description: The number of tokens that text generation or chat generated.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiStopReason.description: Why the model stopped generating, as watsonx.ai reports it, such as max_tokens or eos_token for text generation and stop, length or tool_calls for chat.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiForecastInputSchema.description: The input schema for time series forecast: an InputSchema, or a Map with the keys timestamp_column, id_columns, freq and target_columns (a List or a comma separated String for the columns)

CamelIBMWatsonxAiForecastData.description: The forecast data: a ForecastData, or a Map of column name to the List of its values

CamelIBMWatsonxAiForecastPredictionLengt.description: The number of time steps to forecast, overriding the predictionLength option

CamelIBMWatsonxAiForecastFutureData.description: The known future values of the exogenous columns, for deploymentForecast only: a ForecastData, or a Map of column name to the List of its values

CamelIBMWatsonxAiForecastResults.description: The forecast of forecast and deploymentForecast, which is also the body.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiForecastInputDataPoints.description: The number of data points that forecast or deploymentForecast received.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiForecastOutputDataPoint.description: The number of data points that forecast or deploymentForecast returned.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiFoundationModels.description: The foundation models that listModels returns, which are also the body.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiFoundationModelTasks.description: The tasks of the foundation models that listTasks returns, which are also the body.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiFoundationModelFilter.description: The filter of listModels, in the syntax of the filters parameter of watsonx.ai, such as function_text_chat, modelid_ibm/granite-4-h-small or function_rerank,!function_embedding:and (or a com.ibm.watsonx.ai.foundationmodel.filter.Filter)

CamelIBMWatsonxAiFoundationModelTechPrev.description: Whether listModels includes the tech preview models

CamelIBMWatsonxAiToolName.description: The name of the utility tool that runTool runs with the body as its input, such as GoogleSearch or Wikipedia. Required for runTool unless the CamelIBMWatsonxAiToolRequest header is set.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiToolRequest.description: The complete request of runTool, in the place of the CamelIBMWatsonxAiToolName and CamelIBMWatsonxAiToolConfig headers and the body.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiToolConfig.description: The configuration of the utility tool, as a Map, when runTool builds the request from the CamelIBMWatsonxAiToolName header.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiUtilityTools.description: The utility tools that listTools returns, which are also the body.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiToolRegistry.description: The tool registry that processToolCalls runs the tool calls of the model with. Required for processToolCalls, which keeps it on the message for the next chat.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiToolCalls.description: The tool calls of the answer of chat, chatStreaming or deploymentChat. Removed when the answer has none, and by processToolCalls once it ran them.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiHasToolCalls.description: Whether the answer of chat, chatStreaming or deploymentChat calls tools. processToolCalls sets it to false once it ran them.

CamelIBMWatsonxAiAssistantMessage.description: The first answer of chat, chatStreaming or deploymentChat, with its tool calls. processToolCalls reads it, which it requires, and removes it.

producerIn.description: The prompt or text for textGeneration, tokenize, detect, detectContext (the input), detectGenerated (the generated text) and deploymentGenerate, the file path, ID or file name for the text extraction and classification operations that do not upload, read as text unless a header such as CamelIBMWatsonxAiInput gives it: a Map or a POJO fails, as Camel reads it only as its toString(). chat, chatStreaming and deploymentChat take the user message, read as text the same way, a ChatMessage, or the conversation as a List of ChatMessage in which a String is a user message (any other element fails); embedding and rerank take one text, read as text the same way, or a List of Strings. The upload operations take a file, a stream or bytes, with the CamelIBMWatsonxAiFileName header unless it is a file. runTool takes a Map (structured) or a String; forecast a TimeSeriesRequest unless the CamelIBMWatsonxAiForecastInputSchema and CamelIBMWatsonxAiForecastData headers give it

producerOut.description: The generated text for textGeneration, chat, deploymentGenerate, deploymentChat and the streaming operations, the extracted text for textExtractionUploadAndFetch and textExtractionReadFile, the tool output for runTool, with token counts and the stop reason in headers; textExtractionAndFetch gives the extracted text. embedding gives a List with one List of Floats per input, even for one input; rerank, detect, forecast and the list operations a List of results of the watsonx.ai SDK; tokenize the token count; the uploadFile and delete operations a Boolean. detectContext and detectGenerated give a List of results of the SDK. processToolCalls leaves the body and puts the messages in the CamelIBMWatsonxAiMessages header

label.description: A logical name of your choice for the endpoint. It is not sent to watsonx.ai.

baseUrl.label: common
baseUrl.description: The watsonx.ai API URL of the region, such as https://us-south.ml.cloud.ibm.com or https://eu-de.ml.cloud.ibm.com. The endpoint does not start without it, unless its operation is runTool or listTools, which call the wxUrl instead, or processToolCalls, which runs locally.

projectId.label: common
projectId.description: The ID of the watsonx.ai project in which the operations of foundation models (textGeneration, chat, embedding, rerank, tokenize, forecast and their streaming variants), detection, text extraction and text classification run. Set projectId or spaceId. deploymentInfo looks the deployment up in this project when no space ID is set.

spaceId.label: common
spaceId.description: The ID of the deployment space, in the place of projectId, in which the same operations run. deploymentInfo looks the deployment up in this space; there the CamelIBMWatsonxAiSpaceId header overrides it.

wxUrl.label: common
wxUrl.description: The watsonx.ai platform (WX) API URL of the region, such as https://api.dataplatform.cloud.ibm.com/wx or https://api.eu-de.dataplatform.cloud.ibm.com/wx, which runTool and listTools call. Required for these two operations.

autoRotationCorrection.label: producer
autoRotationCorrection.description: Whether text extraction and classification correct the rotation of the pages

classificationMode.label: producer
classificationMode.description: How text classification classifies: exact (the document type) or binary (whether it is one)

cosUrl.label: producer
cosUrl.description: The endpoint URL of the IBM Cloud Object Storage region of the document and result buckets, such as https://s3.us-south.cloud-object-storage.appdomain.cloud. Required for text extraction and text classification.

deploymentId.label: producer
deploymentId.description: The ID of the deployment of deploymentInfo, deploymentGenerate, deploymentChat and deploymentForecast. The CamelIBMWatsonxAiDeploymentId header overrides it; when neither is set, these operations fail.

detectHap.label: producer
detectHap.description: Whether detect looks for hate, abuse and profanity (HAP), when neither the detectors option nor the CamelIBMWatsonxAiDetectors header is set. When neither detectPii nor detectHap is set, detect uses both detectors.

detectionThreshold.label: producer
detectionThreshold.description: The threshold (0 to 1) of the detectors of detect, detectContext and detectGenerated, but the PII detector, which takes none. The defaults of watsonx.ai apply when not set.

detectors.label: producer
detectors.description: The detectors, comma separated, in the place of detectPii and detectHap: hap, pii and granite_guardian for detect, context_relevance and faithfulness for detectContext (default context_relevance), answer_relevance for detectGenerated (default answer_relevance). The detectionThreshold applies to all but pii

detectPii.label: producer
detectPii.description: Whether detect looks for personal identifiable information (PII), when neither the detectors option nor the CamelIBMWatsonxAiDetectors header is set. When neither detectPii nor detectHap is set, detect uses both detectors.

documentBucket.label: producer
documentBucket.description: The Cloud Object Storage bucket of the documents of text extraction and text classification: the upload operations upload into it, and the operations with a file path read the document from it. Required for these operations.

documentConnectionId.label: producer
documentConnectionId.description: The ID of the connection asset, in the project or space, that gives watsonx.ai access to the documentBucket. Required for text extraction and text classification.

documentLanguages.label: producer
documentLanguages.description: The languages of the documents of text extraction and classification, comma separated ISO 639 codes, such as en,fr

embeddedImages.label: producer
embeddedImages.description: What text extraction does with the images of the document

extractionMode.label: producer
extractionMode.description: The quality of text extraction: standard or high_quality

extractionOutputs.label: producer
extractionOutputs.description: The outputs of text extraction, comma separated: md (the default), json, html, plain_text, page_images. The operations that return the text (AndFetch) take one output, but page_images

frequencyPenalty.label: producer
frequencyPenalty.description: The penalty of chat for tokens in proportion to how often they already appear, from -2 to 2: positive values make the answer repeat itself less. There is no header for it.

governanceInstanceId.label: producer
governanceInstanceId.description: The watsonx.governance instance that runs the detectors of detectContext and detectGenerated (and of detect, in the place of the project or space), which IBM Cloud requires for them

guidedChoice.label: producer
guidedChoice.description: Guided decoding of chat: the answer is one of these comma separated choices

guidedGrammar.label: producer
guidedGrammar.description: Guided decoding of chat: the answer follows this context free grammar (EBNF)

guidedRegex.label: producer
guidedRegex.description: Guided decoding of chat: the answer matches this regular expression

includeReasoning.label: producer
includeReasoning.description: Whether watsonx.ai returns the reasoning of the model, in the CamelIBMWatsonxAiReasoningContent header

jsonSchema.label: producer
jsonSchema.description: A JSON schema (as JSON text) that the chat answer follows (the json_schema response format)

jsonSchemaStrict.label: producer
jsonSchemaStrict.description: Whether the chat answer must follow the jsonSchema strictly

kvpMode.label: producer
kvpMode.description: The key-value pair extraction of text extraction: disabled, invoice, ubill or generic_with_semantic. When not set, text extraction extracts no key-value pairs.

maxCompletionTokens.label: producer
maxCompletionTokens.description: The maximum number of tokens of the answer of chat, chatStreaming and deploymentChat. The CamelIBMWatsonxAiMaxNewTokens header overrides it.

maxNewTokens.label: producer
maxNewTokens.description: The maximum number of tokens that textGeneration, textGenerationStreaming and deploymentGenerate generate. Chat uses maxCompletionTokens instead. The CamelIBMWatsonxAiMaxNewTokens header overrides it.

modelId.label: producer
modelId.description: The ID of the foundation model, such as ibm/granite-4-h-small, of textGeneration, chat, embedding, rerank, tokenize, forecast and their streaming variants. The CamelIBMWatsonxAiModelId header overrides it for chat and chatStreaming. The deployment operations use the model of the deployment instead.

moderationGraniteGuardian.label: producer
moderationGraniteGuardian.description: Chat guardrail: whether watsonx.ai checks the input with Granite Guardian (watsonx.ai applies it to the input only)

moderationHap.label: producer
moderationHap.description: Chat guardrail: whether watsonx.ai checks the input and the answer for hate, abuse and profanity (HAP)

moderationPii.label: producer
moderationPii.description: Chat guardrail: whether watsonx.ai checks the input and the answer for personal identifiable information (PII)

moderationThreshold.label: producer
moderationThreshold.description: The threshold (0 to 1) of the HAP and Granite Guardian chat guardrails

numberOfChoices.label: producer
numberOfChoices.description: How many answers chat generates for the request (n). The body is the first one, and the CamelIBMWatsonxAiAssistantMessages header has them all

ocrMode.label: producer
ocrMode.description: The optical character recognition of text extraction and classification: auto, disabled, enabled or forced

operation.label: producer
operation.description: The operation to perform. The CamelIBMWatsonxAiOperation header overrides it; when neither is set, the exchange fails.

outputDpi.label: producer
outputDpi.description: The resolution, in dots per inch, of the images that text extraction outputs.

outputTokens.label: producer
outputTokens.description: Whether text extraction gives the tokens of the text, with their positions

predictionLength.label: producer
predictionLength.description: The number of time steps to forecast (forecast and deploymentForecast). The model forecasts its own default length when not set

presencePenalty.label: producer
presencePenalty.description: The penalty of chat for any token that already appeared, from -2 to 2: positive values make the model move on to new topics. There is no header for it.

processingTimeout.label: producer
processingTimeout.description: How long the text extraction and classification operations that wait (AndFetch) wait for the result, in milliseconds. Defaults to the timeout of the endpoint

reasoningEffort.label: producer
reasoningEffort.description: How much the model of chat reasons: low, medium or high, for the models that support it

removeOutputFile.label: producer
removeOutputFile.description: Whether the text extraction operations that wait (AndFetch) remove the output file from Cloud Object Storage once read (asynchronously)

removeUploadedFile.label: producer
removeUploadedFile.description: Whether the operations that upload and wait (UploadAndFetch) remove the uploaded document from Cloud Object Storage once the result is read (asynchronously)

repetitionPenalty.label: producer
repetitionPenalty.description: The penalty of text generation for repeating tokens it already generated: 1 means no penalty, and higher values repeat less. Chat does not use it (see frequencyPenalty). The CamelIBMWatsonxAiRepetitionPenalty header overrides it.

rerankTopN.label: producer
rerankTopN.description: The number of best ranked inputs that rerank returns. The CamelIBMWatsonxAiRerankTopN header overrides it.

responseFormat.label: producer
responseFormat.description: The format of the chat answer: text, or json for a JSON object. Set jsonSchema for an answer that follows a JSON schema

resultBucket.label: producer
resultBucket.description: The Cloud Object Storage bucket where text extraction writes its output files, which textExtractionReadFile and textExtractionDeleteFile read and delete unless the CamelIBMWatsonxAiBucketName header names another bucket. Required for text extraction.

resultConnectionId.label: producer
resultConnectionId.description: The ID of the connection asset, in the project or space, that gives watsonx.ai access to the resultBucket. Required for text extraction.

returnDocuments.label: producer
returnDocuments.description: Whether each result of rerank includes its input text, besides its index and score.

seed.label: producer
seed.description: The random seed of chat sampling, for repeatable answers

stop.label: producer
stop.description: Comma separated sequences that stop the generation of the chat answer

streamEndpoint.label: producer
streamEndpoint.description: The endpoint URI, such as seda:chunks, that receives each chunk of textGenerationStreaming and chatStreaming as a message when the CamelIBMWatsonxAiStreamConsumer header is not set. The chunks are sent from the threads of the watsonx.ai SDK, with the exchange ID of the streaming exchange in the CamelCorrelationId header.

temperature.label: producer
temperature.description: The sampling temperature of text generation and chat (the streaming and deployment operations included), from 0 to 2: higher values give more random text. The CamelIBMWatsonxAiTemperature header overrides it.

thinking.label: producer
thinking.description: Whether the model of chat reasons before it answers, for the models that support it (chat template thinking)

thinkingTags.label: producer
thinkingTags.description: For models that write their reasoning in the answer between tags: the tag of the reasoning, and optionally the tag of the answer after a comma, such as think,response. The reasoning goes to the CamelIBMWatsonxAiReasoningContent header and the answer to the body

toolChoice.label: producer
toolChoice.description: How the model chooses the tools of chat: auto (the model decides), required (the model must call a tool), none (the model must not call a tool), or the name of the tool the model must call

topK.label: producer
topK.description: The top-k sampling of text generation: the model picks the next token from this number of most likely tokens. Chat does not use it. The CamelIBMWatsonxAiTopK header overrides it.

topP.label: producer
topP.description: The nucleus sampling of text generation and chat: the model picks the next token from the most likely tokens whose probabilities add up to this value (0 to 1). The CamelIBMWatsonxAiTopP header overrides it.

truncateInputTokens.label: producer
truncateInputTokens.description: The maximum number of tokens of each input text of embedding: a longer input is truncated from the end, so that the request does not fail.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer,advanced
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

logRequests.label: advanced
logRequests.description: Whether to log HTTP requests to the watsonx.ai API

logResponses.label: advanced
logResponses.description: Whether to log HTTP responses from the watsonx.ai API

timeout.label: advanced
timeout.description: The timeout of each HTTP request to watsonx.ai and to IBM Cloud IAM, in milliseconds; the watsonx.ai SDK uses 60 seconds when not set. The streaming operations wait for the end of the stream at most this timeout and 30 seconds more.

apiKey.label: security
apiKey.description: The IBM Cloud API key, exchanged at IBM Cloud IAM for an access token that is sent to watsonx.ai. Required unless oauthProfile or authenticator is set, or the operation is processToolCalls, which runs locally; when several are set, authenticator is used first, then oauthProfile.

oauthProfile.label: security
oauthProfile.description: OAuth profile name for obtaining an access token via the OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials grant. When set, the token of the configured identity provider is sent to watsonx.ai as a Bearer token instead of an IBM Cloud API key, and obtained again when it expires. Requires camel-oauth on the classpath.

verifySsl.label: security
verifySsl.description: Whether the watsonx.ai SDK verifies the TLS certificates of watsonx.ai, IBM Cloud IAM and Cloud Object Storage. Set it to false only for testing, as the connections then accept any certificate.

authenticator.label: security,advanced
authenticator.description: A custom authenticator of the watsonx.ai SDK (com.ibm.watsonx.ai.core.auth.Authenticator) that gives the token of every request, such as a CP4DAuthenticator for watsonx.ai software on Cloud Pak for Data. When set, apiKey and oauthProfile are not used.
